authority: R-168 v1.0 proves a fail-closed schema-shape protocol for a future Pre-A blind holdout and audits a hash-addressed registered snapshot. At the audited checkpoint there are zero official freeze records, zero admitted microscopic survivors, and no admitted M1, M2 or M5 microscopic-map/prediction pair. Therefore no actual prospective holdout can be issued from that snapshot. The validator enforces exact structural keys and declared scalar/container types across the root, contestant, evidence, target, commitment, disclosure, observable, estimand, raw-estimator, candidate-map, prediction, allowed-input, robustness, provenance and scoring objects; requires nonempty root and target identity strings; requires target estimand_id and units to equal the common estimand; requires a nonempty candidate_id-bound prediction for an eligible admitted-map contestant; confines every hash-pinned path to a normalized relative POSIX path inside the repository; requires a parsed HTTPS URL with a hostname; and rejects the registered hostile alias, type, identity, mismatch, duplicate-map, source-reuse, traversal, temporal, hash, baseline and remote-anchor mutations. Its target firewall proves only that no declared target-bearing alias or undeclared payload field is admitted at the structurally controlled locations; it is not a proof against arbitrary target information steganographically encoded in allowed free text. It does not cryptographically verify a custodian signature or fetch and verify a remote tag. It creates no target, freeze record or tag and does not close the parent gate.

initial_local_observation.scope: informational live local freeze/* observation at initial audit execution; not an audited-commit fact, blocker, PASS condition or remote receipt
initial_local_observation.future_compatibility: A future legitimate freeze tag may change this live observation without invalidating the historical R-168 checkpoint audit.

freeze_schema.declared_type_contract: Every declared scalar leaf has its exact Boolean, positive-integer, nonempty-string, digest/OID, UTC-time, null or enum type before semantic comparison; every declared container has its exact object/list type before descent. Contestant, evidence, observable, estimand, raw-estimator, candidate-map, provenance and scoring objects also reject undeclared keys. Remote URLs require scheme https and a nonempty parsed hostname.
freeze_schema.semantic_split: The target estimand and raw-data estimator are candidate-neutral. Each microscopic-to-observable map is candidate-specific and must carry its own theorem, script, hash, domain, state, reference, limit order, units, nuisance inputs and admission status.
freeze_schema.minimum_candidate_condition: The singular frozen prediction must name a nonempty candidate_id that is both score-eligible and backed by an admitted map, and its predicted_relation must be nonempty. This is the one-candidate instance of predictions uniquely keyed by candidate_id. M0 is the mandatory effective null baseline and cannot be scored as the microscopic winner.
freeze_schema.lifecycle: FROZEN_UNSCORED until the later disclosure event and execution of the unchanged frozen scorer.

provenance_protocol.order: custodian commitment issued <= public remote freeze commit/tag < target disclosure <= unchanged frozen scorer execution
provenance_protocol.commitment: Require HMAC-SHA256(K_custodian, domain_separator || 0x00 || RFC8785-JCS(canonical target payload)), with payload schema tect/pre-a-round1-holdout-target-payload/1.0, domain separator TECT-PRE-A-ROUND1-HOLDOUT-TARGET-v1, secret_key_custody=EXTERNAL_CUSTODIAN, and a custodian signature over the commitment metadata. A plain unkeyed hash or author-held key is not accepted.
provenance_protocol.path_policy: Every hash-pinned path must be a normalized relative POSIX path, contain no drive, backslash, absolute prefix, dot segment or parent traversal, and resolve inside the repository. This validator checks the local file hash; the separate remote verifier must bind it to the fetched freeze commit.
provenance_protocol.remote_anchor: Require the public remote commit SHA, remote receipt time, annotated freeze tag freeze/<PRED-ID>/v<N>, tag object ID and custodian signature. The present validator checks only schema shape and local hash pins; a future release verifier must cryptographically validate the signature and independently fetch/verify the remote objects. A local mtime or issued_on field is not temporal evidence.
provenance_protocol.official_record: A future real freeze must use predictions/freezes/<PRED-ID>-freeze.md and a machine sidecar, then receive separate explicit authorization before the annotated git tag is created.

hostile_fixtures.root_extra: Reject an undeclared root payload field.
hostile_fixtures.empty_root_identity: Reject empty freeze_id, prediction_id, round_id or no_overclaim strings directly.
hostile_fixtures.empty_target_identity: Reject empty target_id, custodian, protocol_or_accession, estimand_id or units strings directly.
hostile_fixtures.target_estimand_mismatch: Reject target estimand_id or units that differ from observable_contract.common_estimand.
hostile_fixtures.target_leakage: Reject a freeze containing the target value or reported interval.
hostile_fixtures.hidden_sealed_payload: Reject a sealed_payload hidden inside the exact commitment object.
hostile_fixtures.temporal_order: Reject disclosure not strictly after the public remote freeze.
hostile_fixtures.hash_mutation: Reject a changed candidate, evidence snapshot, map script, raw estimator or scorer hash.
hostile_fixtures.path_traversal: Reject absolute, parent-traversing, non-POSIX or repository-escaping hash paths.
hostile_fixtures.independence: Reject overlap between discovery/fitting evidence and the holdout independence group.
hostile_fixtures.baseline_missing: Reject a tournament with no unique M0 effective null baseline.
hostile_fixtures.duplicate_candidate_map: Reject candidate maps not uniquely keyed by candidate_id.
hostile_fixtures.eligible_map_missing: Reject zero eligible microscopic candidates or candidate maps with ABSENT, CONDITIONAL_POSTHOC or NOT_ADMITTED status.
hostile_fixtures.unbound_prediction: Reject a generic or unknown candidate prediction not bound to an eligible admitted map.
hostile_fixtures.input_source_id_missing: Reject an allowed input with no nonempty source_id.
hostile_fixtures.input_discovery_source_id: Reject an allowed input whose source_id is a discovery or forbidden-fit ID.
hostile_fixtures.input_source_alias: Reject an undeclared discovery_source_id alias in an exact allowed-input row.
hostile_fixtures.nested_wrong_type: Reject malformed nested target, commitment, disclosure, prediction and input shapes with structured error codes.
hostile_fixtures.commitment_scalar_types: Reject list-valued signatures and integer-valued commitment digests or public-key fingerprints.
hostile_fixtures.provenance_oid_scalar_types: Reject integer-valued commit and annotated-tag object IDs.
hostile_fixtures.remote_url_no_hostname: Reject an https URL shape with no parsed hostname.
hostile_fixtures.input_scalar_types: Reject list-valued input classes and null used_for fields without raising a set-membership exception.
hostile_fixtures.contestant_scalar_type: Reject a non-string contestant role without raising a set-membership exception.
hostile_fixtures.estimand_container_type: Reject a non-object common_estimand with a structured error.
hostile_fixtures.estimator_container_type: Reject a non-object raw_estimator with a structured error.
hostile_fixtures.remote_anchor: Reject malformed or absent public commit/tag metadata. This is not cryptographic or remote verification.
